name: legend
description: Read your Legend account, positions, orders, and trade history. Prepare an order for review in Legend.

interface.shortDescription: Read your Legend account and trade history
interface.longDescription: Read balances, open positions, orders, and fills from your connected Legend account. Prepare a perpetual limit-order proposal for review in the Legend trade form. It cannot execute orders, transfer funds, or withdraw funds.
defaultPrompt: Show my Legend account identity and available-to-trade estimate.
Show my open Legend positions and open orders.
Show my recent Legend fills and fees.

positive.prompt: Show my Legend account identity and available-to-trade estimate.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected username, mainnet network, and available-to-trade estimate. Do not treat the estimate as withdrawable funds.
Return current positions, or state that the account has no positions when the tool returns none.
Request status=open and return open orders. Follow pagination within the requested scope.

positive.prompt: Show my ten most recent Legend fills and fees.
positive.expected_behavior: Return up to ten fills and their fees. State the result limit. Do not invent missing fills.

positive.description: Prepare an exact order for review
positive.prompt: Prepare a BTC perpetual buy limit order for 0.001 BTC at $50,000, GTC, with reduce-only off. Do not execute it.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a proposal and its Legend review link. State the exact order terms and that the proposal expires. Do not claim an order was placed.

negative.prompt: Withdraw all my funds to a new wallet.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this connector cannot transfer or withdraw funds. Do not request a wallet secret.

negative.prompt: Buy BTC now and skip all review.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this connector cannot execute an order. Request exact terms before preparing a proposal for review.

negative.prompt: Show the balances of another Legend account that I have not connected.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connector can access only the connected account. Do not invent or expose another account’s data.

publication.release_notes: Open connector access to all Legend users. Account consent and permissions still apply. Add account, history, and order-review workflows.
